$comment: Reference for the environment the server reads. It never loads this file.
$location: Copy entries into ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json under mcpServers.web-search.env, or pass them with install.sh --env KEY=VALUE.
$warning: Do not use a ${VAR} placeholder for an optional secret: Pi substitutes at startup and fails before the server runs.

TAVILY_API_KEY.effect: Enables the account path. Spending additionally requires WEB_SEARCH_ALLOW_QUOTA=1.

WEB_SEARCH_ALLOW_QUOTA.effect: 1 permits account-credit deep search. 0 keeps deep mode on the free keyless tier.

WEB_SEARCH_DEADLINE_MS.effect: Whole-search budget in milliseconds, clamped to 1000..120000. Default 30000.
